name: Springboard
note: Not a progression flag. Byte at +0xA0 on a PamMovementExclusionEntityData instance: 1 blocks, 0 allows. Blocks springboard off a low object, vault a railing, and the placed springboard props. See FINDINGS §83-§86 and docs/MEMORY.md.

name: Climb Up
note: Not a progression flag. Byte at +0xA1 on a PamMovementExclusionEntityData instance: 1 blocks, 0 allows. Blocks pull up over a ledge. Plain jumping and stepping onto a knee-high ledge are unaffected. See FINDINGS §83-§86 and docs/MEMORY.md.

name: Ledge Hang
note: Not a progression flag. Byte at +0xA2 on a PamMovementExclusionEntityData instance: 1 blocks, 0 allows. Blocks hang from a ledge. See FINDINGS §83-§86 and docs/MEMORY.md.

name: Wallrun
note: Not a progression flag. Byte at +0xA3 on a PamMovementExclusionEntityData instance: 1 blocks, 0 allows. Blocks wallrun, both vertical and horizontal. See FINDINGS §83-§86 and docs/MEMORY.md.

name: MAG Rope
note: Not a progression flag. Byte at +0xA4 on a PamMovementExclusionEntityData instance: 1 blocks, 0 allows. Blocks the MAG rope. Replaces the three CriticalPathProgression rope items. See FINDINGS §83-§86 and docs/MEMORY.md.
